title: OCC Mundial Jobs Scraper
description: Collect job listings and full job details from OCC Mundial (occ.com.mx). Paste an OCC search URL, or use a keyword and location.

url.title: Start URL
url.description: An OCC job search, category, company board, or job detail URL. A custom URL takes priority over keyword and location. Example: https://www.occ.com.mx/empleos/de-contador/en-ciudad-de-mexico/

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Job title, skill, or search term. Used when the Start URL is left at the default general board.

location.title: Location
location.description: Mexican state, city, or neighborhood. Used when the Start URL is left at the default general board. Leave empty for all of Mexico.

results_wanted.title: Maximum results
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of jobs to save to the dataset.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages
max_pages.description: Safety cap on the number of search result pages to visit. Each page holds about 20 jobs.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: OCC protects its search pages with a Cloudflare challenge. Apify Residential proxy is recommended.
